findings.evidence: cache.py:48-53 returns results[-1] from the legacy per-chapter entries layout. Commit b2de792 shows those entries held one chapter's agent result, not a synthesis report, so compare._extract_ratings (compare.py:116-130) finds no dimension_ratings and prints all '-' instead of saying there is no report. This happens only for state dirs left by older versions.
findings.message: ghostreader/cache.py:49–55 — Wrong report loaded. Users comparing manuscripts are hurt: a legacy cache can supply a per-chapter result as the full report, leaving scorecard data missing or invalid.

findings.evidence: canon.py:237-255 _plot filters secrets only by planted_chapter < N, then prints the current state and knowers. With live Canon (no checkpoint, canon.py:94-98), a reveal recorded after chapter N leaks into the state for chapter N. Unlike cast deaths (canon.py:162-164), it does not check state_since_chapter >= N.
findings.message: ghostreader/canon.py:237-255 — Time-inaccurate secret state. Authors may receive false continuity findings or miss real secret-knowledge contradictions when an earlier chapter is checked against a later reveal state.
